metadata.tags: Experimental electronic track characterized by a heavy, distorted bassline and rhythmic vocal sampling. The piece features a prominent, sliding sub-bass synth that creates a warping, glissando effect between notes. A crisp, minimalist drum kit provides a steady 4/4 foundation with sharp snare hits and tight hi-hats. The primary melodic element is a high-pitched, manipulated vocal sample that repeats a rhythmic pattern, processed with heavy reverb and delay to create a sense of space. The production is clean yet aggressive, utilizing side-chain compression to allow the kick drum to punch through the dense low-end frequencies. The tempo is approximately 120 BPM, maintaining a dark, club-oriented atmosphere with industrial textures.
